replay.detail: Existing observations remain valid; no replay or checkpoint change.

schema.detail: Adds optional human.review evidence_tests array. No database DDL or storage version change.

rules.detail: No gate or curator rule change.

compatibility.detail: Legacy review observations remain valid without test citations, but do not gain signed GO authority by omission. General PR snapshot behavior is unchanged.

manual.detail: Deploy the updated schema to participating daemons before publishing new citation fields. Intake cites immutable records it considered; signing adapters follow separately.

recovery.detail: The future protected observer must read head/base together, require the head to match the reviewed snapshot and bind its measured ancestor base into the record. A changed head requires a new review observation.
